# Daisyworld: параметрическое исследование (динамика модели)
Сценарий :ramp, комплексные графики.

```{julia}
import Pkg
Pkg.activate("/home/dabakharev/work/study/2026-1/2026-1==study-simulation-modeling/2026-1-study-simulation-modeling/labs/lab03/project")
using DrWatson

using Agents
using DataFrames
using Plots
using CairoMakie
using StatsBase

ENV["GKSwstype"] = "100"

include("/home/dabakharev/work/study/2026-1/2026-1==study-simulation-modeling/2026-1-study-simulation-modeling/labs/lab03/project/src/daisyworld.jl")

script_name = "daisyworld-luminosity_param"
mkpath(plotsdir(script_name))

black(a) = a.breed == :black
white(a) = a.breed == :white
adata = [(black, count), (white, count)]

param_dict = Dict(
    :griddims => (30, 30),
    :max_age => [25, 40],
    :init_white => [0.2, 0.8],
    :init_black => 0.2,
    :albedo_white => 0.75,
    :albedo_black => 0.25,
    :surface_albedo => 0.4,
    :solar_change => 0.005,
    :solar_luminosity => 1.0,
    :scenario => :ramp,
    :seed => 165,
)

params_list = dict_list(param_dict)

temperature(model) = StatsBase.mean(model.temperature)
mdata = [temperature, :solar_luminosity]

for params in params_list
    println("Прогон: ", params)
    model = daisyworld(; params...)
    agent_df, model_df = run!(model, 1000; adata = adata, mdata = mdata)

    figure = Figure(size = (600, 600))
    ax1 = figure[1, 1] = Axis(figure, ylabel = "daisy count")
    black1 = lines!(ax1, agent_df[!, :time], agent_df[!, :count_black], color = :red)
    white1 = lines!(ax1, agent_df[!, :time], agent_df[!, :count_white], color = :blue)
    figure[1, 2] = Legend(figure, [black1, white1], ["black", "white"])

    ax2 = figure[2, 1] = Axis(figure, ylabel = "temperature")
    ax3 = figure[3, 1] = Axis(figure, xlabel = "tick", ylabel = "luminosity")

    lines!(ax2, model_df[!, :time], model_df[!, :temperature], color = :red)
    lines!(ax3, model_df[!, :time], model_df[!, :solar_luminosity], color = :red)

    for ax in (ax1, ax2); ax.xticklabelsvisible = false; end

    plt_name = savename("daisy-luminosity", params) * ".png"
    save(plotsdir(script_name, plt_name), figure)
end

println("Готово!")
```
